properties.displayName: Connection to a custom network indicator
properties.query:
// Time window the rule runs over — the rule schedule will control this,
// but keeping a filter here protects against accidental long scans.
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(48h)
// Defender’s built‑in title for custom network IOC matches:
| where AlertName == "Connection to a custom network indicator"
// Unpack the Entities array Microsoft includes with each alert
| extend EntitiesJson = todynamic(Entities)
| mv-expand EntitiesJson
| extend EntityType = tostring(EntitiesJson["Type"]),
         Url        = tostring(EntitiesJson["Url"]),
         Domain     = tostring(EntitiesJson["DomainName"]),
         Ip         = tostring(EntitiesJson["Address"])
// Choose a single comparable indicator from URL/Domain/IP
| extend IndicatorRaw = coalesce(Url, Domain, Ip)
| where isnotempty(IndicatorRaw)
// Normalize URLs for readability (strip scheme and trailing slash)
| extend Indicator = iff(
        EntityType == "url",
        trim_end(@"/", replace_string(IndicatorRaw, @"^https?://", "")),
        IndicatorRaw
    )
// Shape the alert payload your custom rule will emit
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    ProductName,        // originating product name in the ingested alert
    AlertName,          // original Defender alert title (for reference)
    SystemAlertId,      // handy if you later PATCH Graph alerts_v2
    AlertLink,          // link back to the source alert
    CompromisedEntity,  // often the device or user
    Indicator,          // the URL/Domain/IP we extracted
    Entities,           // keep raw entities for entity mapping
    ExtendedProperties
